why.title: Price only tells half the story
why.lead: Two hotels both charge 1.2 million VND for Saturday night. One has 14 rooms left, the other has 2. From the rate alone, you can't tell whether the market is heating up or slowing down. OTARadar counts the rooms left first, then puts the rate beside them.

why.confidenceTitle: Channels don't publish room counts. We tell you exactly how sure we are.

exact.name: Exact
exact.text: The page says “Only 2 rooms left”. An exact count, used to measure pace.

capped.name: At least
capped.text: The room selector hits the page's limit. We know for certain at least that many are left.

hidden.name: Hidden
hidden.text: Rooms are available but the page hides the count. Recorded as available, with no guessing.

sold_out.name: Sold out
sold_out.text: The room type disappears or shows as sold out. The calendar is read first, so this is never mistaken for a minimum-stay restriction.

steps.title: Three laps of the market, every day
steps.lead: Every scan runs the same steps in the same order. Each step only uses the output of the one before, so every number on the board traces back to its source page.

calendar.title: Open the 30-day calendar
calendar.text: Read each hotel's calendar first: which nights are on sale and which have a minimum stay. Closed nights don't need a page load.

nights.title: Read every night
nights.text: Load the page for each night with the right minimum stay, recording every room type, rooms left, rate, cancellation policy and breakfast.

compare.title: Compare with last time
compare.text: Check against the latest usable observation to catch sell-outs, restocks, shrinking availability and rate changes of 3% or more.

brief.title: Morning brief
brief.text: Market summary, demand signals, pricing opportunities and risks, with every insight linked to its source data.

rescan.title: Two more scans
rescan.text: Keep up with nights that are selling fast. Scan times, scans per day and nights tracked can all be adjusted to your time zone.

briefSection.title: The 07:30 brief only says what the data can prove
briefSection.lead: Every morning, the latest scan is combined with events from the past 24 hours and 7 days, comp set metrics, PMS occupancy and public holidays, then handed to an AI model to write the brief.

principles.title: Considerate collection, transparent numbers
principles.lead: The principles we follow when reading public data for you.

public.title: Public pages only
public.text: We never log in to a booking channel, never use your extranet account and never collect guests' personal data.

pace.title: A considerate pace
pace.text: Page loads are spaced a few seconds apart, never in bursts, and each hotel is read one page at a time.

market.title: True local rates
market.text: Pages are viewed as a guest in the hotel's own country. Rates stay in the displayed currency, never converted.

archive.title: Source pages kept
archive.text: Source pages are stored for a while (30 days by default). When a channel changes its layout, the data is re-read instead of lost.

limits.title: Clear about limits
limits.text: We currently track Booking.com, Agoda, iVIVU and Trip.com, counting rooms separately for each channel. Every search assumes 2 adults, so single-occupancy room types don't appear.

account.q: Does OTARadar need my Booking.com account?
account.a: No. The system only reads the public pages any guest can see. Your extranet account is never involved.

accuracy.q: How accurate are the rooms-left counts?
accuracy.a: Booking channels usually only show an exact number when few rooms are left. That is why every number in OTARadar carries a confidence level: exact, at least, hidden or sold out. Pace is only calculated from pairs of exact counts.

hotels.a: Any hotel with a page on Booking.com, Agoda, iVIVU or Trip.com: paste the link to add it to your list. Your own hotel sits in the same list, so it always appears next to your competitors.

channels.a: Booking.com, Agoda, iVIVU and Trip.com. Each channel has its own inventory, so rooms are counted per channel and never added together. Expedia and Traveloka are not supported yet.

timing.q: How soon will I see data?
timing.a: The first scan runs as soon as setup is complete. Events such as sell-outs and rate changes appear from the second scan, and the brief arrives every morning at 07:30.

pms.q: Do I have to connect a PMS?
pms.a: No. Without a PMS you still get the full competitor data. Importing a file from your PMS puts your real occupancy next to the market, both on the board and in the brief.

team.q: Can my whole team use it?
team.a: Yes. Admin accounts manage the watchlist, scan times and PMS imports; view-only accounts are for anyone who just needs to read the numbers.
